To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the strategy of sustainable development of rural areas of the Russian Federation to 2030 is not a guide to action.

1) the Strategy for Sustainable Development of Rural Areas of the Russian Federation for the Period to 2030 is not a document that will be able to guide the country’s rural development; 2) the document contains no clear priorities for rural development, nor does it specify the sources for funding the measures it suggests; 3) the document does not contain a single reference to the rural population, and the term «rural area» is used only once, in the title.
the strategy does not provide a clear and consistent definition of the term «sustainable rural development».
